question: Which of the following ratios is the greatest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the given ratios into approximate percentages for a quick comparison:

20 : 38 ⇒ (20 ÷ 38) × 100 ≈ 52.6%

19 : 43 ⇒ (19 ÷ 43) × 100 ≈ 44.2%

23 : 45 ⇒ (23 ÷ 45) × 100 ≈ 51.1%

13 : 40 ⇒ (13 ÷ 40) × 100 = 32.5%

Comparing the values, 52.6% is the largest percentage.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 : 38.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The ratios to compare are 20 : 38, 19 : 43, 23 : 45, and 13 : 40.
